DOCUMENT 139/78
ORAL QUESTION (0-19/78)
with debate, pursuant to Rule 47 of the Rules of
Procedure, by Mrs KROUWEL-VLAM, on behalf of the
Committee on the Environment, Public Health and
Consumer Protection,
to the Commission of the European Communities
Subject: Community preventive action on
cardio-vascular diseases
Following the symposium held in Luxembourg on 12
April 1978 on the social and political consequences
of cardio-vascular diseases, the Commission of the
European Communities is requested to answer the
following questions:
1. Is it aware that the increased frequency of cardio-
vascular diseases resulting from the modern, pre-
dominantly sedentary life-style now imposes an in-
tolerable financial burden on the social security
systems of the various countries?
2. Does it not feel that the specific actions which
it carries out under chapter 35 of the budget of
the European Communities - radiation protection,
